text.p: Italy's international athletics meeting at altitude in Sestriere, which was scheduled for next weekend, has been cancelled due to lack of funds, organisers said on Monday.
"The 1997 Sestriere international meeting, which was to take place on July 19, has been postponed until the summer of 1998," a statement from the company which manages the resort said.
The statement said Sestriere could not fund the event, estimated to cost one billion lire ($590,000), after hosting the alpine skiing world championships in January.
"The high costs of such competitive sporting events persuaded us to postpone the summer athletics meeting by 12 months," the statement said.
The meeting, at which organisers have traditionally offered a Ferrari car for anyone breaking a world record, would have been one of the last events before next month's world championships in Athens.
